newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales fall 1.8 pct in June yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales fall 1.8 pct in June yr/yr.

text.p: Retail sales in Switzerland, measured by value, fell 1.8 percent in June from the same month last year after a year-on-year rise of 2.8 percent in May and a 3.0 percent fall in June last year, the Federal Statistics Office said on Tuesday.
Adjusted for inflation, the office said real retail turnover in June was 2.0 percent lower than last year, with sales of foods down 3.2 percent and clothes and textiles down by 3.1 percent.
For the first six months of 1997, the value of retail sales was 0.3 percent lower than in the same period of last year.

Adjusted for prices, the office said real sales fell 0.8 percent in the first half of 1997 compared with a decline of 1.7 percent in the second half of 1996 and a 0.7 percent fall in the first half of 1996.
